summary: Iteration 96 — P0 RETEST of the 3 critical security fixes (Tenant KYC + per-tenant Smart Communications). BACKEND: 43/43 pytest green against the public preview URL — 15/15 on the two files delivered by the main agent (test_fork_p0_tenant_kyc.py 8/8 + test_fork_p0_security_gates.py 7/7) and 28/28 on the adversarial suites (new test_iter96_p0_security_retest.py 15/15 + the previously failing test_fork_p0_extra_kyc.py now 13/13). All 3 defects from iteration_95 are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) a non-super-admin tenant admin now gets 403 on GET /api/admin/kyc/{tenant_id} — even for its OWN tenant id — while admin@sawalismartsystems.com still gets 200 (correct payload) / 404 (unknown tenant); (2) a tracked user with tracked_role='Médecin' gets 403 on GET/PUT /api/me/kyc and POST /api/me/kyc/upload/{doc_type}, and the blocked PUT provably did not persist (tenant KYC unchanged when re-read by the tenant admin); (3) the same Médecin gets 403 on GET and PUT /api/me/smart-communications. Positive path preserved: tracked_role='Superviseur' is treated as tenant manager (200 on KYC read/write + smart-comm read), all 11 secret fields still come back blanked with *_masked companions and no cleartext anywhere in the response body, unauthenticated calls are 401/403, and the unique index on tenant_id exists on both db.tenant_kyc and db.tenant_smart_comm (verified via index_information()). FRONTEND: /portal/my-account verified with 3 real accounts — super-admin (role=admin): both tenant-kyc-section + tenant-smart-comm-section render; tracked Médecin (role=client-tracked, tracked_role=Médecin): BOTH sections absent from the DOM (count=0) → UI gate OK; new tracked Superviseur (role=client, tracked_role=Superviseur): both sections render AND full round-trips work — KYC 'Raison sociale' saved and persisted after reload, Smart-Comm wa_waba_id saved and persisted (shown as placeholder after reload), wa_access_token returned masked 'UI••••••••••••••9599'. All 6 channel tabs render their fields (wa/meta/instagram/x/tiktok/linkedin). The internal 'Q3=b : override strict' wording has been removed from the tenant-facing banner. No backend 500s in supervisor logs during the run. Per the request, the sender wiring (issue #4) was NOT retested.

minor.issue: Non-blocking design note: a tenant admin now gets 403 even for its OWN tenant_id (only the super-admin passes). Functionally fine because /api/me/kyc covers the self case, but if any admin UI ever calls /admin/kyc/{own_id} it will break. Consider allowing self-tenant reads explicitly.
Carried over from iter95 (unchanged): MIME validation trusts the client Content-Type only — arbitrary bytes sent as image/png are accepted. No magic-byte sniffing.
Carried over: secrets are still stored in cleartext in db.tenant_smart_comm (masked on read only), and an API consumer sending '' still wipes a token while the UI silently drops empty strings.

ui_bugs.component: MyAccount role gate vs backend gate
ui_bugs.issue: Inconsistency: backend _is_tenant_manager() accepts tracked_role in {'Superviseur','Administrateur'}, but MyAccount.jsx only checks tracked_role === 'Superviseur'. A tracked user with tracked_role='Administrateur' has full API access to the tenant KYC/Smart-Comm but no UI to use it. Align both lists.

REPRODUCED again (pre-existing): the briefing modal (data-testid='welcome-briefing', fixed inset-0 z-[60]) mounts ASYNCHRONOUSLY a few seconds after /portal/my-account renders, so it intercepts pointer events on kyc-save-btn / smart-comm-tab-* even when the page was already interactive. Any click retried for 30s until dismissed. Real users hitting save at that moment get a dead click.
Pre-existing: the centered percentage spinner (29%/49%/85%) keeps overlaying the KYC/Smart-Comm cards while the page is idle — visible in every screenshot.

issues: Saved non-secret values (e.g. WABA ID) come back as grey PLACEHOLDER text instead of a real input value, so a configured field looks empty/unset to the user — only the tiny bullet on the tab hints it is configured
Secret fields still show the masked value twice (placeholder + 'Actuel : …' helper)
Still no per-tab 'configuré' badge to audit the 6 channels at a glance

action_items: LOW: align the frontend gate with the backend — add tracked_role === 'Administrateur' in MyAccount.jsx (line ~263) or drop 'Administrateur' from _is_tenant_manager().
MEDIUM: make WelcomeBriefing mount before/with the page content (or add pointer-events guard) so late mounting does not swallow clicks on the new KYC / Smart-Comm controls.
LOW (UX): render saved Smart-Comm non-secret values as input values (not placeholders) and add a 'configuré' badge per channel tab.
BACKLOG (unchanged, not retested per request): wire db.tenant_smart_comm into the actual senders (_wa_send_text etc.).
LOW: sniff magic bytes on KYC uploads; consider the secrets-vault pattern for tenant_smart_comm storage.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tenant_kyc.py:114 _is_tenant_manager() — role check is lowercased but tracked_role is compared case-sensitively against {'Superviseur','Administrateur'}; a value stored as 'superviseur' or 'SUPERVISEUR' would be denied. Normalise with .lower().

routes/tenant_kyc.py:127 _is_super_admin_user() swallows every exception from is_super_admin() and returns False — safe default, but it will silently deny the real super-admin if _is_super_admin ever raises. Log the exception.

server.py:20828-20829 unique index creation on tenant_kyc/tenant_smart_comm is wrapped in a broad try/except with only a warning — verified present in this env, but a pre-existing duplicate tenant_id would leave the app running without the constraint.
The 403 on /admin/kyc/{own_tenant_id} for tenant admins is now stricter than the documented Q2 rule ('only super-admin cross-tenant'); confirm no admin screen calls it with its own id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested acceptance criteria (gate hidden for tracked regular, visible + functional for admin and tracked Superviseur)

rca_of_the_issue: Fixes verified at the source: routes/tenant_kyc.py now defines _is_tenant_manager() (role admin/superviseur OR tracked_role Superviseur/Administrateur) and applies it to all four /me/* handlers, and _is_super_admin_user() (delegating to server._is_super_admin / SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL) gates /admin/kyc/{tenant_id} on top of get_current_admin. server.py:24063 passes both is_super_admin and super_admin_email into the router, and server.py:20828 creates the unique tenant_id indexes. The frontend gate in MyAccount.jsx:263 now includes tracked_role === 'Superviseur'. Behaviour confirmed end-to-end via API (403/200 matrix) and via real browser sessions for the three role classes.
